subject.title: [Feature]: Feishu Group Chat SubAgents for User-Specific Skills and Memory

question: Should Feishu group chats support automatic per-sender dynamic agents, or should OpenClaw limit group isolation to groupSessionScope plus explicit bindings for now?
rationale: The remaining request changes product behavior, persistent config/state, memory isolation, and security boundaries for group participants; source inspection shows current main has only narrower building blocks.

options.title: Design first, keep open
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned product and security design that decides whether dynamic group agents are allowed and under what limits.

options.title: Narrow to existing primitives
options.body: Document groupSessionScope, explicit bindings, and DM dynamic agents as the supported path, then close or split the broader auto-spawn request.

options.title: Sponsor a Feishu prototype
options.body: Approve a Feishu-plugin implementation plan with quotas, cleanup, admin controls, upgrade proof, and live Feishu validation before code work starts.

recommendation.title: Design first, keep open
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer-owned product and security design that decides whether dynamic group agents are allowed and under what limits.

likelyOwner.reason: The Feishu plugin metadata names @m1heng as the community maintainer, making this the best available product-routing owner for Feishu-specific behavior.
